name: rhiosutoyo/Traveloka-Customer-Review-Sentiment-Analysis-Dataset

why_useful: Traveloka is the dominant Indonesian OTA; a labeled sentiment dataset could be a component of an SE Asia travel-sentiment index, though small (1,200 rows) and social-media rather than transaction data.
